title: Width bound for a gate
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on $n$ sign variables, let $w\in\mathbb{N}$, and let the gate be either AND or OR. The gate has width at most $w$ for $f$ if, when it is AND, $f$ has a conjunctive normal form of width at most $w$, and, when it is OR, $f$ has a disjunctive normal form of width at most $w$.
